svg.aria-label: TradeLogger. Personal trading journal and research platform, now in beta. Read-only by design: it never places an order. Syncs trades from MetaTrader 5 and Capital.com; Analytics, risk sizing and price alerts; Backtesting and strategy-discovery lab; Read-only Gemini assistant for your own history; Web, Electron desktop and Expo mobile clients. Built with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, Electron.
